summary.text: Matt Soper is a Republican who represents District 54 (Delta and Mesa counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where Ballotpedia says he took office on January 4, 2019. Ballotpedia lists Soper as not running for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Soper was born and raised in Delta, Colorado, attended Mesa State College, and earned two law degrees, from the University of Edinburgh and the University of New Hampshire School of Law.
Ballotpedia also says he became owner of three small businesses and served as editor and writer for two law journals.
